dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two prominent, thick white horizontal bands across the wing coverts showing high grayscale contrast against darker feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct and sharp pale white boundaries are clearly visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast white rectangular band is visible across the posterior neck, separating the dark crown from the mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Linear and distinct boundaries separate the black crown from the white nape band and the white nape band from the grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent white outer tail feathers (rectrices) creating a high-contrast outer edge to the tail silhouette.
